title: Active noise cancellation on open-ear smart glasses
abstract: arXiv:2604.05519v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Active noise cancellation (ANC) is widely deployed on consumer headphones and earbuds to suppress environmental noise. However, existing ANC systems require an error microphone at the user's ear canal to measure residual sound, preventing deployment on emerging open-ear wearable devices such as smart glasses and VR headsets, which leave the ear unoccluded. Here we present an ANC system for open-ear wearables that suppresses environmental noise using only microphones and miniaturized open-ear speakers embedded within the frame of the wearables, removing the need for an in-ear error microphone. Our low-latency computational pipeline uses a neural network to estimate the noise at the ear from an array of eight microphones distributed around the wearable's frame and generates an anti-noise signal in real-time. translated_title: 开放式智能眼镜上的主动降噪技术
translated_abstract: 主动降噪（ANC）技术已广泛应用于消费级耳机和耳塞中以抑制环境噪声。然而，现有的ANC系统需要在用户耳道处放置误差麦克风来测量残余声音，这阻碍了其在新一代开放式可穿戴设备（如智能眼镜和VR头显）上的部署，因为这些设备不封闭耳道。本研究提出了一种适用于开放式可穿戴设备的ANC系统，该系统仅使用嵌入在可穿戴设备镜框内的麦克风和微型开放式扬声器来抑制环境噪声，无需入耳式误差麦克风。其低延迟计算流水线利用神经网络，从分布在可穿戴设备镜框周围的八个麦克风组成的阵列估计耳部的噪声，并实时生成反噪声信号。这种映射无需事先进行声学测量即可泛化到未见过的用户和声学环境。研究团队还开发了一套定制的（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需入耳式误差麦克风的开放式智能眼镜主动降噪系统，通过镜框上的八个麦克风阵列和神经网络实时估计耳部噪声并生成反噪声信号，且无需预先声学测量即可泛化至不同用户和声学环境。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an active noise cancellation system for open-ear smart glasses that eliminates the need for in-ear error microphones by using a neural network to estimate ear-level noise from eight frame-mounted microphones and generate anti-noise in real-time, generalizing to unseen users and acoustic environments without prior acoustic measurements.
